s: Lena and I will review the words from our last three days.
Over the last three days, we learned words about the body, words about food, and words about colors.
Hot soup is good in winter.
What do you put in your soup?
I put chicken in my soup.
I also put fish in my soup.
I like to eat fish on Fridays.
Fish with lemon is very good.
Do you put lemon in your soup?
I put lemon in my tea.
My mom drinks tea every morning too.
Hot tea is good in winter.
When I drink hot tea, I feel warm.
Good food makes me feel good.
She puts her bag on her shoulder.
My knee hurts when I run.
The knee is the middle of the leg.
I hear you with my ear.
One finger, two fingers, three, four, five!
I brush my tooth every day.
We need our teeth to eat chicken and fish.
It gets dark early in winter.
In the dark, I cannot see my soup!
In the dark, I drink my tea.
Dark nights are for hot tea.
But now our kitchen is not dark.
